use_case_summary: AstraForge needs a hybrid rollout: start on Redwood Hosted API to iterate quickly on chat and doc-search features; then move to Dedicated VPC for production to meet enterprise data residency and audit requirements. Targets: sustain ~200 qps of embedding+chat mix, 95th latency ~150ms for chat, cost predictability for finance. Preference for open/quantizable models (e.g., Llama-2 class 13B quantized) with automated fallback to smaller variants for burst control. Must support SAML SSO for admin console and forward audit logs to their Splunk instance.
